name: Yagyuu Aoi
source:
A tsundere girl. She is a extremely tomboyish girl who’s trying to reinvent herself as being a lady in front of a total stranger to the town. In general, she’s not very good at it, and watching her try so very hard at it is hilarious. Perhaps her most famous line is loudly shouting “Good Fuck!” when she really meant to say “Good Luck!”

[Edited from [url=http://www.neechin.net/article/73/nagisa-no-thoughts-in-one-playthrough]Agilis' review[/url].]
